title: Comparing crop evapotranspiration estimation methods to evaluate water-saving potential of alternative land uses in the San Joaquin Valley, California

passages.note: The independent applied study uses OpenET SSEBop outputs, identifying their Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature input. It separately uses a USGS VIIRS-based SSEBop evapotranspiration product as a comparator.
